specification.penalty: RSS_K + gamma * log binomial(n-1,K-1); separate fixed-K fits
specification.marginal_weights: exact finite-n uniform admissible configurations conditional on K
specification.amp_configuration_prior: uniform K=1..L, uniform admissible boundaries, uniform source label subsets: any constant label for K=1; label 0 then increasing subsets for K>=2

hausdorff_convention: Mean and actual 25th/75th percentiles of normalized Hausdorff distance conditional on a successful nonempty estimate; empties are undefined.
count_convention: Mean and actual 25th/75th percentiles over all successful estimates, including empty estimates as zero; the true count is two.
histogram_convention: Successful fits pooled as cp/n; canonical 12 data-range bins and fivefold Gaussian KDE; common density display range 0..24 covers every peak. Empty fits contribute no locations. Variable-count fits contribute one observation per estimated boundary.
